entities.page_title: Expansion of Interview Waiver Eligibility for U.S. Visa Holders from Pakistan
entities.title: Expansion of Interview Waiver Eligibility for U.S. Visa Holders from Pakistan
entities.summary: The United States Mission in Pakistan has expanded interview waiver eligibility for Pakistani citizens renewing B1/B2 tourist and business visas. Eligible applicants can renew their visas without an interview if they are 45 years or older and their previous visa is valid or has expired within the last 48 months.
eligibility: B1/B2 visa valid or expired within the last 48 months
important_notes: Some eligible visa holders may still be required to appear for an interview
Applicants can check their eligibility for an interview waiver on the U.S. Embassy's website
